svg.title: Illustrative pet insurance claim waterfall
svg.desc: Illustrative arithmetic. A 2000 dollar vet bill, minus a 250 dollar deductible, leaves 1750. Eighty percent reimbursement leaves 1400. An excluded 100 dollar exam fee leaves a 1300 dollar payout. Not a Canadian average and not a policy. 26 Sep 2026.
svg.text: $2,000 bill, $250 deductible, 80 percent reimbursement, $100 exam excluded. Every input is made up for the arithmetic.
NAPHIA did not publish a Canadian average deductible or reimbursement percent. Do not treat 80 percent or $250 as typical.
If the exam fee is eligible, the last subtraction does not happen. The wording decides.
